message:
## Vulnerability Digest

**Scan window:** 2026-11-12 05:10 IST to 2026-11-13 05:10 IST (2026-11-11 23:40 to 2026-11-12 23:40 UTC)  
**Scope:** Products.txt and List_of_SIA_Completed.txt only. Obvious aliases and duplicate versioned entries were normalized across those two files. DLL_software_component.txt was not read or combined.

Four high-confidence product matches were found: a PostgreSQL security release covering 52 CVEs, a newly published critical ManageEngine M365 Manager Plus CVE, a critical MongoDB Server issue newly indexed and reported during the window, and an Apache HTTP Server advisory page updated during the window with three fixes. One MongoDB Node.js Driver CVE is retained as a possible match because the CVE-to-vendor-release mapping is not yet explicit on MongoDB's advisory page.

### PostgreSQL security release — 52 CVEs

- **Affected product:** PostgreSQL 14 through 18 and PostgreSQL 19 RC 2.
- **Severity:** Highest vendor-reported CVSS score is 8.8.
- **Description:** PostgreSQL published fixes for 52 security issues, including multiple arbitrary-code-execution, SQL-injection, authorization-bypass, information-disclosure, and denial-of-service flaws. Notable 8.8-scored examples include CVE-2026-6460, CVE-2026-18447, CVE-2026-116304 through CVE-2026-116307, CVE-2026-116314 through CVE-2026-116320, and CVE-2026-120139 through CVE-2026-120151.
- **Relevance:** PostgreSQL is explicitly listed in Products.txt and PostgreSQL 15 is also present in List_of_SIA_Completed.txt.
- **Source:** [PostgreSQL 18.7/17.12/16.16/15.20/14.25 release advisory](https://www.postgresql.org/about/news/postgresql-187-1712-1616-1520-1425-and-19-rc-2-released-3442/)

### CVE-2026-12591 — ManageEngine M365 Manager Plus

- **Severity:** Critical, CVSS 9.9 (CNA score).
- **Description:** An authenticated technician can exploit missing permission validation in the delegated-administration interface to escalate privileges and potentially execute code remotely. Builds before 4818 are affected; build 4818 fixes the issue.
- **Relevance:** ManageEngine is listed in Products.txt. The CVE record was published on 2026-11-12 at 06:55 UTC, within the scan window.
- **Source:** [ManageEngine advisory](https://www.manageengine.com/microsoft-365-management-reporting/CVE-2026-12591.html)

### CVE-2026-118383 — MongoDB Server replica-set primary catch-up

- **Severity:** Critical, CVSS 9.5 (MongoDB vendor score).
- **Description:** A pre-authentication use-after-free in replication primary catch-up can terminate a replica-set member and, under some conditions, permit code execution in the server process. Standalone mongod instances are not affected.
- **Affected versions:** MongoDB Server 4.4 before 4.4.32, 5.0 before 5.0.35, 6.0 before 6.0.30, 7.0 before 7.0.48, 8.0 before 8.0.37, 8.3 before 8.3.16, and 9.0 before 9.0.7.
- **Relevance:** MongoDB is explicitly listed in Products.txt and ROBOMONGO appears in List_of_SIA_Completed.txt. MongoDB's vendor alert is dated November 10, while the CVE record and new technical reporting surfaced during this window; MongoDB says Atlas maintenance applies fixed versions automatically unless maintenance is deferred.
- **Sources:** [MongoDB product alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts), [MongoDB announcement](https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/important-mongodb-security-update-available-action-required-november-10-2026/344843)

### Apache HTTP Server 2.4.71 security fixes

- **Severity:** Critical (CVE-2026-119618), Important (CVE-2026-106023), and Low (CVE-2026-109163), per Apache.
- **Description:** CVE-2026-119618 is a mod_http2 synchronization flaw that can cause heap corruption and remote code execution in versions 2.4.55 through 2.4.70. CVE-2026-106023 is a mod_md NULL-pointer denial of service affecting 2.4.30 through 2.4.70. CVE-2026-109163 is a one-byte mod_vhost_alias stack overwrite affecting 2.4.69 and 2.4.70.
- **Relevance:** Apache HTTP Server is explicitly listed in Products.txt and apache2 appears in List_of_SIA_Completed.txt. Apache released 2.4.71 on November 11; its authoritative vulnerability page was updated on November 12 at 07:46 UTC, inside this scan window.
- **Source:** [Apache HTTP Server 2.4 vulnerability advisory](https://httpd.apache.org/security/vulnerabilities_24)

### Possible match needing review — CVE-2026-126837

- **Product:** MongoDB Node.js Driver.
- **Severity:** Not clearly stated by an authoritative source located in this run.
- **Description:** The newly published CVE describes insufficient validation of DNS SRV results that may redirect a driver connection to an attacker-selected host. MongoDB's release notes state that Node Driver versions 3.3.3 through versions before 7.8.0 are affected by the same SRV host-verification issue.
- **Why review is needed:** The technical issue and affected range match MongoDB's official 7.8.0 release warning, but MongoDB's public release page does not yet display CVE-2026-126837 next to that warning.
- **Source:** [MongoDB Node.js Driver 7.8.0 release notes](https://github.com/mongodb/node-mongodb-native/releases/tag/v7.8.0)

### MongoDB ecosystem coverage

The dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, mongod, mongos, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, major maintained libraries and services, MongoDB-owned alerts, CVE/NVD records, GitHub Security Advisories, CISA sources, and credible security research. CVE-2026-118383 was confirmed as the primary fresh server finding; CVE-2026-126837 remains a possible driver match pending an explicit first-party CVE mapping. No other in-window MongoDB-category finding survived freshness and relevance validation.

**Closing:** Immediate review is recommended for PostgreSQL, MongoDB replica-set deployments, ManageEngine M365 Manager Plus below build 4818, and Apache HTTP Server below 2.4.71 where the affected modules are enabled.
